_comment: STAGED, DORMANT hooks — kbind ships these wired-but-inert (ready-but-inert, ADR-0007/D19). Installing the plugin activates NONE of them. To enable a gate, copy the block(s) you want into the `hooks` object of YOUR repo's .claude/settings.json (NOT the plugin — keep the plugin updatable). ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} resolves to the installed plugin. ⚠️ #52218: after a plugin update that changes a hook, run /plugin update.

hooks._what: context hygiene — strip ANSI color from Bash output
maker≠checker — block git commit unless a quality gate ran <30min ago
records a passing quality gate (feeds commit-gate.sh)
maker≠checker — block on a violated Spec status ladder
